# has translator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTranslator`](gmeow-hasTranslator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTranslator>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work to an agent that translated it into another language or notation. A flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasTranslator`](gmeow-hasTranslator.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of naming a translator; typically attaches at the [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) tier, since a translation is a distinct [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) of the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the translation's period, degree, confidence, or source-text must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) with [`gmeow:roleTranslator`](../individuals/gmeow-roleTranslator.md)), and avoid attaching it to the language-neutral [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md).

### How to use

- Assert from the translated [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to the agent; promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) carrying [`gmeow:roleTranslator`](../individuals/gmeow-roleTranslator.md) when metadata is needed.

### Examples

- ex:hamletGermanTranslation [`gmeow:hasTranslator`](gmeow-hasTranslator.md) ex:schlegel.
